about_the_game:
Important Update – Classic Edition

This Classic Edition for players who want to support my first game.
A full Remake using a new engine and new systems is planned as a free update for all existing owners.

If you prefer a more polished experience, you  want to wait for the Remake before buying or reviewing this version.

About this Classic Edition

The Secret Story: Classic Edition is the first game where I tried to shape this concept, learn game systems, and build everything completely on my own.
Through this game, I wanted to share strange and mysterious stories I’ve heard from all around the world.

Creating and releasing these stories has been a lot of fun, and I’m truly grateful to everyone who showed interest and supported this first step. Thank you so much!

Next in the series – The Secret Story: Car Owner (working title)

I’ve now decided to develop a new entry in the series, built on a completely new gameplay system:

Key Feature

  • Upgraded visuals with a new engine

  • Fully revamped gameplay systems

  • More missions and greater player freedom

  • A brand-new story in the spirit of The Secret Story

A note for existing players

Because of these changes, this game is now treated as the old / Classic Edition of the series.

The franchise will continue in a new, more exciting form with the upcoming game.

As a token of my appreciation:

  • When the DEMO of The Secret Story: Car Owner becomes available,

  • Development of the Remake of The Secret Story: Classic Edition will begin,

  • And once it’s finished, all current owners of this Classic Edition will receive the Remake as a free update.

Come chat with me and the community on my Discord!

Thank you once again,
UDAGamelab

If you enjoyed it, please consider wishlisting Chapter 2. ❤️

short_description: On the night of Friday the 13th, Henry Caviar was just a traveler seeking relaxation at a hotel. He helped a young woman who warned him about the "ghost hunting day," leading him to encounter numerous bizarre events that made him feel he had been mistaken.
